summary: Frontend-only smoke of Vocotap batch fixes. Home logo + single-star BEST row correct, editor-first flow works, editor records tap/hold/wavy (count=3), Save toast + 'Saved' state, export shows 'Chart file exported', library refresh works on all 3 tabs, difficulty grid shows immediately (no Auto-building), Voco Warmup Easy generate&play enters gameplay with wavy ribbon rendering, results screen renders (5 stars row, 45.45% accuracy, +50 Starlites). One preview-only issue: Treesh-Music-tab songs without a playable uri (CORS blocks treesh.app) still let you tap Play from Song screen and end at game's 'Chart not ready' fallback instead of showing analysis error card.

ui_bugs.issue: For songs without a playable uri (Treesh Music entries in preview where treesh.app content is CORS-blocked), tapping play-generated-chart-button navigates to /game which then falls through to the 'Chart not ready — Build a chart' screen instead of showing the analysis error card (retry/back/edit). Reproduced with Treesh Music → 'Bankrupt (Freestyle)'. Voco Warmup (built-in with uri) works fine end-to-end.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warns: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"', '"textShadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "textShadow"', 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Pre-existing across screens; not blocking but worth cleaning up before ship.

action_items: In analysis.tsx play(), if !selectedSong.uri: skip navigation to /game and set phase='error' (or disable the Play button + show hint) so Treesh songs missing audio degrade gracefully instead of landing on game's 'Chart not ready' screen.
Optional cleanup: migrate remaining shadow*, textShadow*, and props.pointerEvents usages to RN 0.76+ web-friendly equivalents to silence console noise.
critical_code_review_comments: game.tsx guard on line 418 uses !selectedSong?.uri; that fallback is fine, but analysis.tsx doesn't check uri before calling generateFor + router.replace('/game'), leading to a dead-end for Treesh songs without cached audio.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview blocks treesh.app CORS, so treeshSongs may lack uri. Use device tab 'Voco Warmup' for a fully-playable end-to-end run. Gameplay uses keyboard A/S/D/F on web. All fixed items in the review request verified working; only pre-existing minor gap is the Treesh-without-uri → game 'Chart not ready' dead-end.
rca_of_issue: Analysis play() eagerly navigates to /game after generateFor(), but game.tsx also requires selectedSong.uri. Treesh Music tab entries returned by the fallback catalog can lack a playable uri when the network catalog is CORS-blocked, so navigation succeeds and only game screen shows the 'Chart not ready' guard. Add a uri check in analysis.tsx play() before router.replace('/game').
